title: How the Guild Works
description: Learn how to find, register and complete paid guild contracts.
completion_text: The receptionist explained how to register notices, track contracts and collect payment.

stages.title: The Reception Desk
stages.lead: Find the Guild Receptionist and ask about contracts.
notes: Take a notice from the guild board and hold it to register.
Track objectives in your journal and return for payment.
Registering a class, with optional starter gear, is a separate first quest.

objectives.description: Ask the Guild Receptionist about guild contracts.
